pages.title: Cliffs Hotel and Spa - Pismo Beach, California - The Cliffs Hotel and Spa - Pismo Beach, California
pages.description: Perched on the majestic cliffs above Pismo Beach, The Cliffs Hotel and Spa offers a California coastal retreat where relaxation meets adventure. Lounge by our oceanfront pool, savor breathtaking sunsets & views, dine with local ingredients, or indulge in our luxurious spa. Discover why The Cliffs Hotel and Spa is one of the most sought-after hotels in Pismo Beach for locals and travelers alike.
